message:
I revised draft Plan A. It is a draft only, so nothing is saved or registered and your enrollment is unchanged.

What changed: I swapped capstone 90004 for the alternate 90006. The plan is now 90001, 90002, 90006 and 90010.

Why: 90004 meets Mon/Wed 8:00-9:15 am. That falls inside your new Monday restriction (no classes before 10:00 am), so it no longer works.

Is it feasible? Yes. It comes to 13 credits with no rule errors.
- Capstone: 90006 is CAP4000 section 06, Tue/Thu 10:00-11:40 am. It has 1 open seat.
- Linked lab: CAP4000 requires lab 90010, which meets Thu 5:30-6:20 pm and is in the plan.
- Prerequisite: CAP4000 needs CS3000 or CS3500. You completed CS3000 with a B, so it is met.
- Protected courses: 90001 (Mon 10:00-11:15 am) and 90002 (Wed 1:00-2:15 pm) are both kept. 90001 starts exactly when your Monday restriction ends, so it fits.
- Work and Monday restrictions: Your blocks are Tue/Thu 12:00-5:00 pm and Mon before 10:00 am. 90006 ends at 11:40 am, before work starts. The lab starts at 5:30 pm, after work ends. Nothing overlaps.
- Credits: 13 is within your 12-16 limit.
- Time conflicts: None.

Tradeoffs:
- Afternoon preference: 90006 is a morning section, so this soft preference isn't met. The afternoon section, 90005, is full with 3 people on its waitlist.
- Seat availability: 90006 has only 1 seat left, so it could fill before you register.
- Current enrollment: You're enrolled in 90001, 90002 and 90003. Plan A leaves out 90003, so registering it would drop that course. I won't do that unless you ask.

Would you like to keep this version, or save it?
